text:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: High error rate (502/500) from routing service for customer 'bluewave' — ROI traffic hitting incompatible runtime. check /incidents for details

emily.k: Seeing a spike of gen->embed fallbacks in eu-west-1 metrics. 502s correlate with model negotiation failures.

emily.k: root cause looks like a legacy pin on the customer route: model_alias: 'rw-chat-legacy-v1' that our smart router maps to a chat-optimized variant on some hosts but to an instruct/embedding fallback on others. mismatched runtime ABI -> 502 schema errors.

raj.s: Confirmed. Logs from router (excerpt):
```
2026-03-15T12:02:41Z router[pid=2241] WARN route_eval: pinned_model_alias=rw-chat-legacy-v1 resolved_variant=embed-instruct-quant
2026-03-15T12:02:41Z runtime[pid=4302] ERROR serve: incompatible-variant-schema: expecting chat.proto but got embed.proto
```

maria-pm: Customer 'bluewave' reported degraded search ranking (embedding vectors missing) — they're hitting timeouts. CS opened a ticket.

emily.k: Immediate mitigation options: 1) Unpin the legacy alias so smart router can pick compatible variant; 2) Rollback alias mapping to previous stable commit; 3) Temporarily route bluewave to dedicated capacity in us-east while we fix eu-west mapping.

ops-sre: Can we do a quick alias rollback? What's the safe command?

emily.k: Use infra-tooling: `infra alias set rw-chat-legacy-v1 --mapping=rw-chat-stable-v2 --force` but that will affect all customers using that alias. safer: scope the override to the customer route: `infra route override --route bluewave --alias rw-chat-legacy-v1 --mapping=rw-chat-stable-v2`

emily.k: I'll prepare the route-override. tagging @raj for runtime compatibility check.

raj.s: Doing a dry-run on staging now. If we split traffic 90/10 and push the override, we can watch for regressions.

oncall-bot: Incident channel created: #incident-1728346120. Pager escalation level: P1. Next on-call: harry (in 30m).

harry: I'll take the handoff at 12:30 UTC, leaving notes here.

emily.k: Quick mitigation implemented: route override applied for bluewave -> rw-chat-stable-v2 with 100% for eu-west-1. Monitoring.

ops-sre: After override, error rate dropped ~85% in eu-west. Still seeing a handful of 502s from older nodes that cache alias mapping. Purging alias cache with `routerctl cache flush --alias rw-chat-legacy-v1` helped.

raj.s: We've instrumented an alert rule gap: router resolves alias to variant types but doesn't validate per-variant ABI before admitting traffic. Filed infra ticket INF-4321 to add variant compatibility check in routing path.

customer-success-bot: Notifying bluewave support contact: "We're actively mitigating an issue causing missing embeddings. We'll follow up with RCA and ETA for full fix."

maria-pm: Please capture customer impact: affected region eu-west-1, timeframe ~12:01-12:22 UTC, approx 12% of bluewave calls returned 5xx, business impact: search ranking staleness for ~1500 users.

emily.k: Postmortem action items: [1] Add pre-route ABI validation (INF-4321) [2] Add alias cache invalidation on override (OPS-221) [3] Add circuit-breaker routing when variant-type mismatch detected (RUNTIME-99) [4] Notify customers with timeline and mitigation steps (CS-44). I'll own #1 and #2.

harry: Taking over incident lead. I'll run a quick sweep of other pinned aliases for similar legacy mappings and post results in 15m.

ops-sre: Handoff notes: keep override in place until we deploy a compatibility guard; rollback only after full verification. Contact list: emily.k, raj.s, harry.

emily.k: Also found a config drift in our region map: eu-west routing table had an older alias map from last year. Fixing sync job to push global alias state to regional routers (SRE job alias-sync).

raj.s: Adding logs excerpt and a small repro in case we need to run offline tests:
```
# reproduce: simulate request with model_alias=rw-chat-legacy-v1 and payload type=embedding
bash$ curl -X POST https://router.eu-west-1.redwood/api/v1/generate -d '{"model_alias":"rw-chat-legacy-v1","input":"embed this"}'
# expected: runtime returns embed vector
# observed: runtime error incompatible-variant-schema
```

customer-success-bot: Bluewave support acknowledged. They requested estimated time to full fix. ETA TBD after engineering RCA.

harry: I'll coordinate RCA doc and timeline. leaving incident in detection->mitigated state. Will post final postmortem link when ready. :white_check_mark:

oncall-bot: Incident status changed to: mitigated. Next steps: RCA and rollout of compatibility check.
